summary: Audio sender RTT is now read from the paired LiveKit remote-inbound-rtp report, the source that carries the receiver's round-trip-time measurement. The compact mobile voice dock no longer has a redundant expand chevron, hint area or expansion gesture. Automated checks and a signed Android split release pass; live peer RTT and native device acceptance remain open.

checks.name: LiveKit paired remote-inbound RTT tests
checks.observation: The matched remote-inbound report provides RTT; an outbound report's unrelated value is ignored, and a missing paired report yields unavailable RTT.

checks.name: Voice badge and compact dock regression tests
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart test/voice_connection_badge_test.dart
checks.observation: 46 tests passed, including measured/unavailable ping semantics and compact dock controls without expandable content.

checks.name: Android 1.0.6+10 signed split release
checks.observation: Built armv7 29,473,895 bytes; arm64 38,328,845 bytes; x86_64 44,083,078 bytes. apksigner verified APK Signature Scheme v2 on all three; certificate SHA-256 394e369de2d566b4897493ee498da2f27745e514c49ca88c6489b0b0a811212b. All split APKs are below the GitVerse 100 MB asset limit and remain local build outputs, not Git files.

checks.name: Live peer ping and native device acceptance
checks.observation: No physical peer session was used to validate live RTT delivery or the rendered compact dock on-device.

checks.name: GitVerse Android release workflow
checks.observation: The android-v1.0.6 tag has not yet been published for CI during evidence authoring.

remaining: Publish and confirm the android-v1.0.6 GitVerse release workflow, then validate live audio RTT and compact dock behavior with an Android device and a connected peer.
